candidates.summary: Replit published research on scaling laws for agent swarms: more agents can give large gains, but unlike traditional scaling laws more compute does not necessarily mean better results, and how agents organize matters.

Anthropic opened Zero Data Retention with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards in public beta on the Claude Platform: encrypted copies of Messages API traffic go to the customer's own cloud storage, with automated misuse checks.
OpenAI and Cisco introduced Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime that lets agents write dynamic eBPF controls to shield systems from exploits while patches are tested.
OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber helped validate 948 Linux kernel bugs that could grant local root access in one run and generate patches for review; researchers worked with maintainers to get fixes upstream.

a16z and The Prompting Company tested four consumer agents across 1,270 prompts and 11,307 completed runs on what gets a product found and chosen by an AI agent; specific customer needs can overturn an agent's default.
facts: Instinct linked only to the brand's own store in 45% of answers (a16z post)
